}
.sw-case.acc-green {
  --ac-700:#046c53; --ac-600:#059669; --ac-500:#0fae7a; --ac-400:#34d399;
  --ac-300:#6ee7b7; --ac-200:#a7f3d0; --ac-50:#ecfdf5; --ac-border:#baefd6; --ac-ink:#065f46;
  --ac-shadow:rgba(5,150,105,.22);
}
.sw-case.acc-red {
  --ac-700:#9f1239; --ac-600:#be123c; --ac-500:#e11d48; --ac-400:#fb7185;
  --ac-300:#fda4af; --ac-200:#fecdd3; --ac-50:#fff1f3; --ac-border:#f9ccda; --ac-ink:#9f1239;
  --ac-shadow:rgba(190,18,60,.20);
}

.sw-case-intro { font-size:.95em; color:var(--sw-ink-soft); line-height:1.7; margin:26px 0 12px; }
.sw-case-intro .sw-caseno {
    display:inline-block; font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:0.66em; font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#fff;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sw-b700), var(--sw-b500));
    padding:4px 10px; border-radius:6px; margin-right:10px;
    box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(29,78,216,0.25); vertical-align:middle;
}
.sw-compare { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:20px; margin:14px 0; }

.sw-case { border:1px solid var(--sw-border); border-radius:var(--sw-r-md); background:var(--sw-surface); box-shadow:var(--sw-shadow-sm); overflow:hidden; margin:0; transition:box-shadow .3s, border-color .3s; }
.sw-case[open] { box-shadow:var(--sw-shadow-lg); border-color:var(--ac-border); }
.sw-case > summary { list-style:none; cursor:pointer; padding:20px 22px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:20px; }
.sw-case > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; }
.sw-case-body details > summary, .sw-agg details > summary { list-style:none; cursor:pointer; }
.sw-case-body details > summary::-webkit-details-marker, .sw-agg details > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; }
.sw-case-body details > summary::before, .sw-agg details > summary::before { content:"▸"; display:inline-block; margin-right:7px; color:var(--ac-400); transition:transform .2s ease; font-size:.85em; }
.sw-case-body details[open] > summary::before, .sw-agg details[open] > summary::before { transform:rotate(90deg); }

.sw-score { flex:0 0 auto; width:76px; height:76px; border-radius:16px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ac-700),var(--ac-500)); color:#fff; display:grid; place-items:center; text-align:center; box-shadow:0 8px 20px var(--ac-shadow); line-height:1; }
.sw-score b { font-family:var(--sw-font-display); font-size:1.7em; }
.sw-score span { font-size:.62em; opacity:.9; font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); margin-top:2px; }
.sw-case-mid { flex:1 1 auto; min-width:0; }
.sw-case-eyebrow { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:7px; margin-bottom:7px; }
.sw-chip { font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.64em; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ac-600); background:var(--ac-50); border:1px solid var(--ac-border); padding:3px 9px; border-radius:999px; }
.sw-chip.alt { color:var(--sw-ink-muted); background:var(--sw-surface-sunken); border-color:var(--sw-border); text-transform:none; letter-spacing:0; }
.sw-verdict { font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.64em; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#fff; background:var(--ac-600); padding:3px 9px; border-radius:999px; }
.sw-case-mid h4 { font-family:var(--sw-font-display); font-size:1.26em; font-weight:600; color:var(--sw-ink); margin:2px 0 5px; }
.sw-case-sub { font-size:.9em; color:var(--sw-ink-muted); line-height:1.6; margin:0 0 8px; }
.sw-case-metrics { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:14px; font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.72em; color:var(--ac-600); }
.sw-case-metrics span { position:relative; padding-left:14px; }
.sw-case-metrics span::before { content:""; position:absolute; left:0; top:50%; width:6px; height:6px; margin-top:-3px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ac-300); }
.sw-case-cta { flex:0 0 auto; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; color:var(--ac-600); font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.72em; font-weight:600; }
.sw-case-cta .chev { display:inline-flex; transition:transform .3s ease; }
.sw-case[open] .sw-case-cta .chev { transform:rotate(90deg); }
@media (max-width:640px){ .sw-case-cta .sw-cta-txt{ display:none; } .sw-case>summary{ gap:14px; } }

.sw-case-body { border-top:1px solid var(--sw-border); padding:6px 22px 26px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fcfdff,#ffffff); }
.sw-sec-h { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.7em; letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ac-600); font-weight:600; margin:26px 0 12px; }
.sw-sec-tick { width:16px; height:2px; background:var(--ac-400); border-radius:2px; }
.sw-prob { background:var(--ac-50); border:1px solid var(--ac-border); border-radius:var(--sw-r-sm); padding:16px 18px; }
.sw-prob-txt { font-size:.9em; line-height:1.7; color:var(--sw-ink-soft); white-space:pre-wrap; max-height:260px; overflow:auto; }

/* zoom */
.sw-zoom { position:relative; }
.sw-zoom-bar { position:sticky; top:6px; z-index:6; display:inline-flex; gap:3px; margin:0 0 8px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.94); border:1px solid var(--sw-border); border-radius:9px; padding:4px; box-shadow:var(--sw-shadow-sm); }
.sw-zoom-bar button { min-width:28px; height:26px; border:none; background:transparent; color:var(--ac-600); font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:13px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; border-radius:6px; padding:0 7px; }
.sw-zoom-bar button:hover { background:var(--ac-50); }
.sw-zoom-bar .sw-zoom-lvl { color:var(--sw-ink-muted); font-size:11px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:0 4px; }
.sw-zoom-view { overflow:auto; }
.sw-zoom-stage { transform-origin:0 0; }

/* flow rail */
.sw-flow { position:relative; margin-left:7px; padding-left:28px; border-left:2px solid var(--ac-border); }
.sw-round { position:relative; margin:0 0 22px; }
.sw-round::before { content:""; position:absolute; left:-36px; top:3px; width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ac-500); border:3px solid #fff; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--ac-200); }
.sw-round.final::before { border-radius:4px; background:var(--ac-700); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--ac-300); }
.sw-round-head { margin-bottom:10px; }
.sw-round-title { font-family:var(--sw-font-display); font-size:1.06em; font-weight:600; color:var(--ac-ink); }
.sw-round-desc { font-size:.8em; color:var(--sw-ink-muted); font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); margin-top:1px; }

.sw-mnode { border:1px solid var(--ac-border); border-left:3px solid var(--ac-600); border-radius:9px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--ac-50),#ffffff); margin:0 0 10px; overflow:hidden; }
.sw-mnode.terminal { border-left-color:var(--ac-700); }
.sw-mnode-sum { padding:11px 15px; font-size:.86em; color:var(--sw-ink-soft); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; }
.sw-node-role { font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.72em; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em; color:#fff; background:var(--ac-700); padding:2px 8px; border-radius:5px; }
.sw-mnode-body { padding:2px 15px 14px; }
.sw-assign { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 0; border-top:1px dashed var(--ac-border); }
.sw-assign-id { font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.78em; font-weight:600; color:var(--ac-700); }
.sw-deps { display:inline-flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:5px; }
.sw-dep { font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.64em; color:var(--ac-700); background:var(--ac-50); border:1px solid var(--ac-border); border-radius:5px; padding:1px 6px; }

.sw-anode { border:1px solid var(--sw-border); border-radius:9px; background:var(--sw-surface); margin:8px 0; overflow:hidden; transition:border-color .25s, box-shadow .25s; }
.sw-anode[open] { border-color:var(--ac-border); box-shadow:var(--sw-shadow-sm); }
.sw-anode-sum { padding:11px 15px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.sw-anode-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--ac-500); flex:0 0 auto; }
.sw-anode-dot.fail { background:#cbd5e1; }
.sw-anode-id { font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.84em; font-weight:600; color:var(--sw-ink); }
.sw-anode-meta { margin-left:auto; font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.7em; color:var(--sw-ink-muted); }
.sw-anode-body { padding:4px 15px 14px; }

.sw-steps { margin-top:8px; border-top:1px solid var(--sw-border); }
.sw-step { display:flex; gap:11px; padding:9px 0; border-top:1px dashed #eef1f6; }
.sw-step:first-child { border-top:none; }
.sw-step-idx { flex:0 0 auto; width:24px; text-align:right; font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.7em; color:var(--ac-300); padding-top:3px; }
.sw-step-col { flex:1 1 auto; min-width:0; }

.sw-blk { margin:5px 0; }
.sw-blk > summary { font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.7em; letter-spacing:.04em; color:var(--sw-ink-muted); text-transform:uppercase; }
.sw-blk.reason > summary { color:var(--ac-600); }
.sw-blk pre { white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word; font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.76em; line-height:1.6; background:var(--sw-surface-sunken); border:1px solid var(--sw-border); border-radius:8px; padding:11px 13px; margin:7px 0 0; max-height:340px; overflow:auto; color:var(--sw-ink-soft); }
.sw-blk.reason pre { background:var(--ac-50); border-color:var(--ac-border); font-family:var(--sw-font-body); font-size:.86em; color:var(--sw-ink-soft); }
.sw-blk.answer pre { background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--ac-50),#fdfefe); border-color:var(--ac-border); font-family:var(--sw-font-body); font-size:.86em; max-height:460px; color:var(--sw-ink); }
.sw-blk.sys pre, .sw-blk.task pre { background:#fbfcfe; }
.sw-call { display:block; margin:8px 0; padding:9px 11px; border:1px solid var(--sw-border); border-left:3px solid var(--ac-500); border-radius:8px; background:var(--sw-surface-raised); }
.sw-call-head { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.sw-call-label { font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.64em; letter-spacing:.09em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--sw-ink-muted); }
.sw-toolpill { font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.7em; font-weight:600; color:#fff; background:var(--ac-500); padding:3px 9px; border-radius:6px; flex:0 0 auto; }
.sw-toolpill.python { background:var(--ac-700); }
.sw-call-params { margin-top:7px; }
.sw-arg { margin:7px 0 0; }
.sw-arg:first-child { margin-top:0; }
.sw-arg-k { display:block; font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.64em; color:var(--ac-600); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em; margin-bottom:3px; }
.sw-arg pre { white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word; font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.74em; line-height:1.55; background:var(--sw-surface-sunken); border:1px solid var(--sw-border); border-radius:6px; padding:8px 10px; margin:0; max-height:260px; overflow:auto; color:var(--sw-ink-soft); }

.sw-rubric-top { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; margin-bottom:8px; }
.sw-rubric-score { flex:0 0 auto; }
.sw-rubric-score b { font-family:var(--sw-font-display); font-size:1.7em; color:var(--ac-700); }
.sw-rubric-score span { font-size:.82em; color:var(--sw-ink-muted); }
.sw-rubric-track { flex:1 1 auto; height:12px; background:var(--sw-surface-sunken); border:1px solid var(--sw-border); border-radius:7px; overflow:hidden; }
.sw-rubric-fill { height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ac-700),var(--ac-400)); border-radius:7px; }
.sw-rubric-item { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; padding:10px 0; border-top:1px solid #eef1f6; font-size:.9em; }
.sw-rubric-dot { flex:0 0 auto; width:19px; height:19px; border-radius:50%; display:grid; place-items:center; font-size:.68em; font-weight:700; color:#fff; margin-top:1px; }
.sw-rubric-dot.full { background:var(--ac-600); }
.sw-rubric-dot.part { background:var(--ac-300); }
.sw-rubric-dot.none { background:#cbd5e1; }
.sw-rubric-txt { flex:1 1 auto; color:var(--sw-ink-soft); line-height:1.6; }
.sw-rubric-pts { flex:0 0 auto; font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.78em; color:var(--sw-ink-muted); white-space:nowrap; }

/* ============================================================
   Aggregate@4 super-flow — a wide, pan/zoom 2D graph.
   ============================================================ */
.sw-agg { position:relative; border:1px solid var(--sw-border); border-radius:var(--sw-r-md); background:var(--sw-surface); box-shadow:var(--sw-shadow-sm); margin:22px 0; overflow:hidden; }
.sw-agg::after { content:""; position:absolute; left:1px; right:1px; bottom:1px; height:44px; pointer-events:none; background:linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,0), rgba(255,255,255,0.92)); border-radius:0 0 var(--sw-r-md) var(--sw-r-md); }
.sw-agg-head { padding:18px 22px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--sw-border); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fcfdff,#fff); }
.sw-agg-head .sw-score { width:70px; height:70px; }
.sw-agg-head h4 { font-family:var(--sw-font-display); font-size:1.26em; font-weight:600; color:var(--sw-ink); margin:0 0 4px; }
.sw-agg-head p { font-size:.88em; color:var(--sw-ink-muted); margin:0; line-height:1.6; }
.sw-agg-view { overflow:auto; height:82vh; min-height:600px; background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(37,99,235,.06) 1px, transparent 0) 0 0/26px 26px, #ffffff; cursor:grab; }
.sw-agg-view.grabbing { cursor:grabbing; }
.sw-agg-stage { transform-origin:0 0; padding:26px; width:max-content; }
.sw-agg-cols { display:flex; gap:22px; align-items:flex-start; }
.sw-agg-col { width:300px; flex:0 0 auto; border:1px solid var(--sw-border); border-top:3px solid var(--ac-500); border-radius:12px; background:#fff; box-shadow:var(--sw-shadow-sm); overflow:hidden; }
.sw-agg-col-head { padding:13px 15px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--sw-border); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; }
.sw-agg-col-badge { flex:0 0 auto; width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:12px; display:grid; place-items:center; text-align:center; color:#fff; line-height:1; background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ac-700),var(--ac-500)); box-shadow:0 5px 14px var(--ac-shadow); }
.sw-agg-col-badge b { font-family:var(--sw-font-display); font-size:1.2em; }
.sw-agg-col-badge span { font-size:.56em; font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); opacity:.9; }
.sw-agg-col-h { min-width:0; }
.sw-agg-col-h .r { font-family:var(--sw-font-display); font-weight:600; color:var(--sw-ink); font-size:1.02em; }
.sw-agg-col-h .m { font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.68em; color:var(--sw-ink-muted); }
.sw-agg-col-body { padding:10px 13px 14px; max-height:340px; overflow:auto; }
.sw-agg-col-body .sw-flow { font-size:.92em; }
/* verdict-tinted columns: pass vs weak */
.sw-agg-col.pass { --ac-700:#046c53; --ac-600:#059669; --ac-500:#0fae7a; --ac-400:#34d399; --ac-300:#6ee7b7; --ac-200:#a7f3d0; --ac-50:#ecfdf5; --ac-border:#baefd6; --ac-ink:#065f46; --ac-shadow:rgba(5,150,105,.22); }
.sw-agg-col.weak { --ac-700:#a1526b; --ac-600:#b45f7b; --ac-500:#c77d95; --ac-400:#d99db0; --ac-300:#e7bccb; --ac-200:#f0d4de; --ac-50:#fbf1f4; --ac-border:#efd6df; --ac-ink:#8a3d56; --ac-shadow:rgba(160,82,107,.18); }

.sw-agg-funnel { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; margin:6px 0 4px; }
.sw-agg-funnel .bus { width:calc(100% - 40px); height:2px; background:var(--sw-border-blue); margin-top:20px; }
.sw-agg-funnel .down { width:2px; height:26px; background:var(--sw-border-blue); }
.sw-agg-funnel .lab { font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.72em; color:var(--sw-b600); background:#fff; padding:4px 12px; border:1px solid var(--sw-border-blue); border-radius:999px; margin:8px 0; }
.sw-agg-funnel .arrow { color:var(--sw-b500); font-size:1.1em; line-height:1; }
.sw-agg-final { border:1px solid var(--sw-b500); border-radius:12px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--sw-b50),#fff); box-shadow:var(--sw-shadow-md); max-width:1268px; overflow:hidden; }
.sw-agg-final-head { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:16px 18px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--sw-border-blue); }
.sw-agg-final-head .sw-score { background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--sw-b800),var(--sw-b500)); box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(29,78,216,.28); }
.sw-agg-final-head h4 { font-family:var(--sw-font-display); font-size:1.2em; font-weight:600; margin:0 0 3px; color:var(--sw-ink); }
.sw-agg-final-head p { margin:0; font-size:.84em; color:var(--sw-ink-muted); }
.sw-agg-final-body { padding:14px 18px 18px; }
.sw-agg-delta { font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.7em; font-weight:700; color:#fff; background:var(--sw-b600); padding:2px 8px; border-radius:5px; margin-left:8px; }

/* rendered markdown inside answer/report blocks */
.sw-md { font-size:.9em; line-height:1.7; color:var(--sw-ink); max-height:460px; overflow:auto; }
.sw-blk > .sw-md { margin-top:7px; background:var(--sw-surface-sunken); border:1px solid var(--sw-border); border-radius:8px; padding:11px 13px; }
.sw-blk.reason > .sw-md { background:var(--ac-50); border-color:var(--ac-border); }
.sw-blk.sys > .sw-md, .sw-blk.task > .sw-md, .sw-blk.sc > .sw-md { background:#fbfcfe; }
.sw-blk.answer > .sw-md { background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--ac-50),#fdfefe); border-color:var(--ac-border); max-height:520px; }
.sw-md > *:first-child { margin-top:0; }
.sw-md h1,.sw-md h2,.sw-md h3,.sw-md h4,.sw-md h5 { font-family:var(--sw-font-display); color:var(--sw-ink); line-height:1.25; margin:15px 0 6px; }
.sw-md h1{font-size:1.28em} .sw-md h2{font-size:1.15em} .sw-md h3{font-size:1.04em} .sw-md h4{font-size:.98em}
.sw-md p{margin:8px 0}
.sw-md ul,.sw-md ol{margin:8px 0; padding-left:20px}
.sw-md li{margin:3px 0}
.sw-md code{font-family:var(--sw-font-mono); font-size:.85em; background:var(--ac-50); color:var(--ac-700); border:1px solid var(--ac-border); border-radius:5px; padding:.06em .36em}
.sw-md pre.sw-md-pre{background:var(--sw-b950); color:#d7e3fb; border-radius:8px; padding:12px 14px; overflow:auto; margin:8px 0}
.sw-md pre.sw-md-pre code{background:none;border:none;color:inherit;padding:0}
.sw-md blockquote{border-left:3px solid var(--ac-300); margin:8px 0; padding:2px 12px; color:var(--sw-ink-soft)}
.sw-md hr{border:none;border-top:1px solid var(--sw-border);margin:12px 0}
.sw-md table.sw-md-table{border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; margin:10px 0; font-size:.9em}
.sw-md table.sw-md-table th,.sw-md table.sw-md-table td{border:1px solid var(--sw-border); padding:6px 9px; text-align:left; vertical-align:top}
.sw-md table.sw-md-table th{background:var(--ac-50); color:var(--ac-700); font-weight:600}
.sw-md a{color:var(--ac-600)}
/* zoom removed: aggregate view is a plain horizontal-scroll container */
.sw-agg-view{cursor:default}
.sw-agg-stage{transform:none!important; width:max-content}
</style>

<script id="sw-case-lib">
window.SWCase = (function(){
  function el(t,c,txt){ var e=document.createElement(t); if(c)e.className=c; if(txt!=null)e.textContent=txt; return e; }
  function fmt(n){ return (Math.round(n*10)/10).toString(); }

  // ---- minimal, safe markdown -> html (for rendered report/answer blocks) ----
  function esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;'); }
  function inline(s){
    var ic=[];
    s=String(s).replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,function(_,c){ ic.push(esc(c)); return '␀IC'+(ic.length-1)+'␀'; });
    s=esc(s);
    s=s.replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g,'<strong>$1</strong>').replace(/__([^_]+)__/g,'<strong>$1</strong>');
    s=s.replace(/(^|[^*])\*([^*\n]+)\*/g,'$1<em>$2</em>');
    s=s.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)/g,'<a href="$2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">$1</a>');
    s=s.replace(/␀IC(\d+)␀/g,function(_,n){ return '<code>'+ic[+n]+'</code>'; });
    return s;
  }
  function mdToHtml(src){
    src=String(src||'').replace(/\r\n/g,'\n');
    var codes=[];
    src=src.replace(/```([^\n]*)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g,function(_,lang,code){ codes.push(code); return '␀CODE'+(codes.length-1)+'␀'; });
    var lines=src.split('\n'), out=[], i=0;
    var blockStart=/^(#{1,6})\s|^\s*([-*+])\s|^\s*\d+[.)]\s|^\s*>|^␀CODE\d+␀\s*$/;
    while(i<lines.length){
      var ln=lines[i];
      var mc=ln.match(/^␀CODE(\d+)␀\s*$/);
      if(mc){ out.push('<pre class="sw-md-pre"><code>'+esc(codes[+mc[1]])+'</code></pre>'); i++; continue; }
      if(/^\s*$/.test(ln)){ i++; continue; }
      var h=ln.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+(.*)$/);
      if(h){ var lv=h[1].length; out.push('<h'+lv+'>'+inline(h[2])+'</h'+lv+'>'); i++; continue; }
      if(/^\s*([-*_])(\s*\1){2,}\s*$/.test(ln)){ out.push('<hr>'); i++; continue; }
      if(/\|/.test(ln) && i+1<lines.length && /^\s*\|?[\s:|-]*-[\s:|-]*\|?\s*$/.test(lines[i+1])){
        var cells=function(r){ var a=r.split('|').map(function(x){return x.trim();}); if(a.length&&a[0]==='')a.shift(); if(a.length&&a[a.length-1]==='')a.pop(); return a; };
        var head=cells(ln); i+=2; var rows=[];
        while(i<lines.length && /\|/.test(lines[i]) && !/^\s*$/.test(lines[i])){ rows.push(cells(lines[i])); i++; }
        var t='<table class="sw-md-table"><thead><tr>'+head.map(function(c){return '<th>'+inline(c)+'</th>';}).join('')+'</tr></thead><tbody>';
        rows.forEach(function(r){ t+='<tr>'+r.map(function(c){return '<td>'+inline(c)+'</td>';}).join('')+'</tr>'; });
        out.push(t+'</tbody></table>'); continue;
      }
      if(/^\s*>\s?/.test(ln)){ var bq=[]; while(i<lines.length && /^\s*>\s?/.test(lines[i])){ bq.push(lines[i].replace(/^\s*>\s?/,'')); i++; } out.push('<blockquote>'+inline(bq.join(' '))+'</blockquote>'); continue; }
      var ordered=/^\s*\d+[.)]\s+/.test(ln), unordered=/^\s*[-*+]\s+/.test(ln);
      if(ordered||unordered){
        var tag=ordered?'ol':'ul', items=[];
        while(i<lines.length){
          var m2=lines[i].match(ordered?/^\s*\d+[.)]\s+(.*)$/:/^\s*[-*+]\s+(.*)$/);
          if(!m2) break; items.push(m2[1]); i++;
        }
        out.push('<'+tag+'>'+items.map(function(it){return '<li>'+inline(it)+'</li>';}).join('')+'</'+tag+'>'); continue;
      }
      var para=[ln]; i++;
      while(i<lines.length && !/^\s*$/.test(lines[i]) && !blockStart.test(lines[i]) && !/^\s*([-*_])(\s*\1){2,}\s*$/.test(lines[i])){ para.push(lines[i]); i++; }
      out.push('<p>'+inline(para.join(' '))+'</p>');
    }
    return out.join('\n');
  }

  function mdDetails(label,cls,txt,open){ var d=el('details',cls); if(open)d.open=true; d.appendChild(el('summary',null,label)); var b=el('div','sw-md'); d.appendChild(b); var done=false; function fill(){ if(done)return; done=true; b.innerHTML=mdToHtml(txt); } if(open)fill(); else d.addEventListener('toggle',function(){ if(d.open)fill(); }); return d; }
  function block(label,cls,txt){ return mdDetails(label,cls,txt,false); }
  function reason(txt,label){ return mdDetails(label||'reasoning','sw-blk reason',txt,false); }
  function answer(txt,label){ return mdDetails(label||'answer','sw-blk answer',txt,true); }
  function sectionHead(txt){ var h=el('div','sw-sec-h'); h.appendChild(el('span','sw-sec-tick')); h.appendChild(el('span',null,txt)); return h; }
  function deps(dep){ var w=el('span','sw-deps'); if(dep&&dep.length){ dep.forEach(function(d){ w.appendChild(el('span','sw-dep', d==='*'?'← all completed':'← '+d)); }); } return w; }

  function callBlock(c){
    var w=el('div','sw-call'), head=el('div','sw-call-head');
    var pill=el('span','sw-toolpill'+(c.tool==='python_interpreter'?' python':'')); pill.textContent=c.tool||'tool';
    head.appendChild(pill); head.appendChild(el('span','sw-call-label','tool call')); w.appendChild(head);
    var keys=c.args?Object.keys(c.args):[];
    if(keys.length){
      var params=el('div','sw-call-params');
      keys.forEach(function(k){ var g=el('div','sw-arg'); g.appendChild(el('span','sw-arg-k',k)); g.appendChild(el('pre',null,c.args[k])); params.appendChild(g); });
      w.appendChild(params);
    }
    return w;
  }
  function renderSteps(box,steps){
    steps.forEach(function(s,i){
      var st=el('div','sw-step'); st.appendChild(el('span','sw-step-idx',String(i+1)));
      var col=el('div','sw-step-col');
      if(s.reasoning) col.appendChild(reason(s.reasoning,'reasoning'));
      (s.calls||[]).forEach(function(c){ col.appendChild(callBlock(c)); });
      (s.responses||[]).forEach(function(r){ col.appendChild(block('tool response','sw-blk resp',r)); });
      if(s.answer) col.appendChild(answer(s.answer,'answer + self-assessment'));
      st.appendChild(col); box.appendChild(st);
    });
  }
  function agentNode(a){
    var d=el('details','sw-anode'), s=el('summary','sw-anode-sum');
    s.appendChild(el('span','sw-anode-dot'+(a.ok?'':' fail')));
    s.appendChild(el('span','sw-anode-id',a.agent_id));
    s.appendChild(deps(a.depends_on));
    s.appendChild(el('span','sw-anode-meta',(a.steps?a.steps.length:0)+' steps · '+(a.ok?'completed':(a.termination||'failed'))));
    d.appendChild(s);
    var b=el('div','sw-anode-body'); d.appendChild(b);
    var done=false;
    d.addEventListener('toggle',function(){ if(d.open&&!done){ done=true;
      if(a.system) b.appendChild(block('system prompt','sw-blk sys',a.system));
      if(a.task) b.appendChild(block('user task','sw-blk task',a.task));
      var steps=el('div','sw-steps'); renderSteps(steps,a.steps||[]); b.appendChild(steps);
    }});
    return d;
  }
  function mainNode(t){
    var d=el('details','sw-mnode'), s=el('summary','sw-mnode-sum');
    s.appendChild(el('span','sw-node-role','MAIN')); s.appendChild(el('span',null,'dispatch rationale · assigns '+t.agents.length+' agents')); d.appendChild(s);
    var b=el('div','sw-mnode-body');
    if(t.reasoning) b.appendChild(reason(t.reasoning,'orchestrator reasoning'));
    var head=el('div','sw-call-head'); head.style.margin='10px 0 2px';
    var pill=el('span','sw-toolpill'); pill.textContent='swarm_run'; head.appendChild(pill);
    head.appendChild(el('span','sw-call-label','tool call · dispatches '+t.agents.length+' sub-agents')); b.appendChild(head);
    if(t.shared_context) b.appendChild(block('shared_context','sw-blk sc',t.shared_context));
    t.agents.forEach(function(a){
      var row=el('div','sw-assign'); row.appendChild(el('span','sw-assign-id',a.agent_id)); row.appendChild(deps(a.depends_on));
      row.appendChild(block('task','sw-blk task',a.task)); b.appendChild(row);
    });
    d.appendChild(b); return d;
  }
  function buildFlow(data){
    var f=el('div','sw-flow');
    var disp=data.main.turns.filter(function(t){return t.kind==='dispatch';});
    var byR={}; (data.agents||[]).forEach(function(a){ (byR[a.round]=byR[a.round]||[]).push(a); });
    disp.forEach(function(t){
      var r=el('div','sw-round'), h=el('div','sw-round-head');
      h.appendChild(el('div','sw-round-title','Round '+t.round));
      h.appendChild(el('div','sw-round-desc',t.agents.length+' sub-agents dispatched')); r.appendChild(h);
      r.appendChild(mainNode(t));
      (byR[t.round]||[]).forEach(function(a){ r.appendChild(agentNode(a)); });
      f.appendChild(r);
    });
    var fin=data.main.turns.filter(function(t){return t.kind==='answer';})[0];
    if(fin){
      var r=el('div','sw-round final'), h=el('div','sw-round-head');
      h.appendChild(el('div','sw-round-title','Final answer')); h.appendChild(el('div','sw-round-desc','main agent folds everything into the deliverable')); r.appendChild(h);
      var d=el('details','sw-mnode terminal'), s=el('summary','sw-mnode-sum');
      s.appendChild(el('span','sw-node-role','MAIN')); s.appendChild(el('span',null,'reasoning + final report')); d.appendChild(s);
      var b=el('div','sw-mnode-body'); if(fin.reasoning) b.appendChild(reason(fin.reasoning,'orchestrator reasoning')); b.appendChild(answer(fin.answer,'final report')); d.appendChild(b);
      r.appendChild(d); f.appendChild(r);
    }
    return f;
  }
  function rubricEl(data){
    var box=el('div','sw-rubric'), top=el('div','sw-rubric-top');
    var sc=el('div','sw-rubric-score'); sc.appendChild(el('b',null,fmt(data.meta.awarded))); sc.appendChild(el('span',null,' / '+fmt(data.meta.total)+' points')); top.appendChild(sc);
    var tr=el('div','sw-rubric-track'), fl=el('div','sw-rubric-fill'); fl.style.width=(100*data.meta.awarded/data.meta.total)+'%'; tr.appendChild(fl); top.appendChild(tr); box.appendChild(top);
    (data.rubrics||[]).forEach(function(r){
      var it=el('div','sw-rubric-item'), aw=(r.awarded==null?0:r.awarded), full=aw>=r.points-1e-9, none=aw<=1e-9;
      var dot=el('span','sw-rubric-dot '+(full?'full':(none?'none':'part'))); dot.textContent=full?'✓':(none?'✕':'~'); it.appendChild(dot);
      var txt=el('span','sw-rubric-txt'); txt.innerHTML=inline(String(r.item).replace(/^\s*\d+[.)]\s*/,'')); it.appendChild(txt);
      it.appendChild(el('span','sw-rubric-pts',fmt(aw)+' / '+fmt(r.points))); box.appendChild(it);
    });
    return box;
  }

  function renderCase(mount, data, opts){
    opts=opts||{};
    var root=el('details','sw-case'+(opts.accent?(' acc-'+opts.accent):''));
    var sum=el('summary','sw-case-card');
    var score=el('div','sw-score'); score.appendChild(el('b',null,fmt(data.meta.awarded))); score.appendChild(el('span',null,'/ '+fmt(data.meta.total))); sum.appendChild(score);
    var mid=el('div','sw-case-mid'), eye=el('div','sw-case-eyebrow');
    if(data.meta.subject) eye.appendChild(el('span','sw-chip',data.meta.subject));
    if(opts.tag) eye.appendChild(el('span','sw-chip alt',opts.tag));
    if(opts.verdict) eye.appendChild(el('span','sw-verdict', opts.verdict==='correct'?'✓ correct':'✕ wrong'));
    mid.appendChild(eye);
    mid.appendChild(el('h4',null, opts.title||'Case study'));
    if(opts.tagline) mid.appendChild(el('div','sw-case-sub',opts.tagline));
    var nRounds=data.main.turns.filter(function(t){return t.kind==='dispatch';}).length;
    var nSteps=(data.agents||[]).reduce(function(a,x){return a+(x.steps?x.steps.length:0);},0);
    var met=el('div','sw-case-metrics'); met.appendChild(el('span',null,nRounds+' rounds')); met.appendChild(el('span',null,(data.agents||[]).length+' sub-agents')); met.appendChild(el('span',null,nSteps+' tool steps')); mid.appendChild(met);
    sum.appendChild(mid);
    var cta=el('div','sw-case-cta'); cta.appendChild(el('span','sw-cta-txt','Explore trajectory'));
    var chev=el('span','chev'); chev.innerHTML='<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="9 6 15 12 9 18"/></svg>';
    cta.appendChild(chev); sum.appendChild(cta);
    root.appendChild(sum);
    var body=el('div','sw-case-body'); root.appendChild(body);
    var built=false;
    root.addEventListener('toggle',function(){ if(root.open&&!built){ built=true;
      if(data.main && data.main.system){ body.appendChild(sectionHead('Main agent system prompt')); body.appendChild(block('orchestrator system prompt','sw-blk sys',data.main.system)); }
      body.appendChild(sectionHead('User task'));
      var p=el('div','sw-prob'); p.appendChild(el('div','sw-prob-txt',data.question)); body.appendChild(p);
      body.appendChild(sectionHead('Orchestration trajectory'));
      body.appendChild(buildFlow(data));
      body.appendChild(sectionHead('Rubric-based evaluation'));
      body.appendChild(rubricEl(data));
    }});
    mount.appendChild(root);
  }

  function renderAggregate(mount, data, opts){
    opts=opts||{};
    var root=el('div','sw-agg');
    var head=el('div','sw-agg-head');
    var sc=el('div','sw-score'); sc.appendChild(el('b',null,fmt(data.meta.awarded))); sc.appendChild(el('span',null,'/ '+fmt(data.meta.total))); head.appendChild(sc);
    var ht=el('div'); ht.appendChild(el('h4',null, opts.title||'Aggregating four independent swarms into one report'));
    ht.appendChild(el('p',null, opts.subtitle||'')); head.appendChild(ht);
    root.appendChild(head);
    var view=el('div','sw-agg-view'), stage=el('div','sw-agg-stage');
    var cols=el('div','sw-agg-cols');
    (data.swarms||[]).forEach(function(sw){
      var norm=sw.awarded/sw.total, pass=norm>=0.7;
      var col=el('div','sw-agg-col '+(pass?'pass':'weak'));
      var ch=el('div','sw-agg-col-head');
      var bdg=el('div','sw-agg-col-badge'); bdg.appendChild(el('b',null,fmt(sw.awarded))); bdg.appendChild(el('span',null,'/'+fmt(sw.total))); ch.appendChild(bdg);
      var chh=el('div','sw-agg-col-h'); chh.appendChild(el('div','r',sw.label)); chh.appendChild(el('div','m', 'independent run · '+(pass?'above 0.7':'below 0.7'))); ch.appendChild(chh);
      col.appendChild(ch);
      var cb=el('div','sw-agg-col-body');
      if(sw.main&&sw.main.system) cb.appendChild(block('system prompt','sw-blk sys',sw.main.system));
      if(data.question) cb.appendChild(block('user task','sw-blk task',data.question));
      cb.appendChild(buildFlow(sw)); col.appendChild(cb);
      cols.appendChild(col);
    });
    stage.appendChild(cols);
    var funnel=el('div','sw-agg-funnel');
    funnel.appendChild(el('div','bus')); funnel.appendChild(el('div','down'));
    funnel.appendChild(el('div','lab','synthesis pass · merge 4 reports → 1')); funnel.appendChild(el('div','arrow','▼'));
    stage.appendChild(funnel);
    var fin=el('div','sw-agg-final');
    var fh=el('div','sw-agg-final-head');
    var fsc=el('div','sw-score'); fsc.appendChild(el('b',null,fmt(data.meta.awarded))); fsc.appendChild(el('span',null,'/ '+fmt(data.meta.total))); fh.appendChild(fsc);
    var fht=el('div'); var h4=el('h4',null,'Aggregated report');
    var best=0; (data.swarms||[]).forEach(function(s){ best=Math.max(best,s.awarded/s.total); });
    var dpts=Math.round((data.meta.awarded/data.meta.total-best)*100);
    h4.appendChild(el('span','sw-agg-delta',(dpts>=0?'+':'')+dpts+' pts vs best single run'));
    fht.appendChild(h4); fht.appendChild(el('p',null,'A single coherent report, merged from all four runs, scored higher than every individual swarm.')); fh.appendChild(fht); fin.appendChild(fh);
    var fb=el('div','sw-agg-final-body');
    var ag=data.aggregate||{};
    fb.appendChild(sectionHead('Synthesis inputs'));
    if(ag.system) fb.appendChild(block('system prompt','sw-blk sys',ag.system));
    if(ag.task) fb.appendChild(block('user task · the four reports','sw-blk task',ag.task));
    if(ag.reasoning) fb.appendChild(reason(ag.reasoning,'synthesis reasoning'));
    fb.appendChild(sectionHead('Aggregated report')); fb.appendChild(answer(ag.report,'final report'));
    fb.appendChild(sectionHead('Rubric-based evaluation')); fb.appendChild(rubricEl(data));
    fin.appendChild(fb); stage.appendChild(fin);
    view.appendChild(stage); root.appendChild(view);
    mount.appendChild(root);
  }

  return { renderCase:renderCase, renderAggregate:renderAggregate };
})();
</script>

<div class="sw-case-intro"><span class="sw-caseno">Case 01</span> <strong>Context by reference vs. by value.</strong> The same hand-off, run both ways on one problem (IChO 1983, Problem 3). Passing an upstream report <em>by reference</em> splices its full text in, so the downstream agent verifies the real report; passing it <em>by value</em> forces the orchestrator to forward a compressed, lossy summary. Same question, opposite outcomes.</div>

<div class="sw-compare">
 <div id="sw-case-ref"></div>
 <div id="sw-case-val"></div>
</div>

Final answer\n\nLet me now produce the final report.","answer":"# Mass Percent Composition of a NaCl/KCl Mixture\n\n**Problem Source:** International Chemistry Olympiad (IChO) 1983, Problem 3.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Problem Statement\n\nA sample containing a mixture of sodium chloride and potassium chloride weighs **25 g**. After dissolution in water, **840 mL** of AgNO₃ solution (*c* = 0.5 mol·dm⁻³) is added. The precipitate is filtered off, and a strip of copper weighing **100.00 g** is dipped into the filtrate. After a given time interval the strip weighs **101.52 g**.\n\n**Calculate the mass percent composition of the mixture.**\n\n---\n\n## 2. Chemical Reactions\n\n**Precipitation of chloride ions** (both NaCl and KCl react identically):\n\n\\[\n\\mathrm{Ag^+(aq) + Cl^-(aq) \\;\\longrightarrow\\; AgCl(s)}\n\\]\n\n**Displacement of excess silver by metallic copper:**\n\n\\[\n\\mathrm{Cu(s) + 2\\,Ag^+(aq) \\;\\longrightarrow\\; Cu^{2+}(aq) + 2\\,Ag(s)}\n\\]\n\nThe copper strip gains mass because the mass of silver deposited (2 × 108 = 216 g per mole Cu) exceeds the mass of copper dissolved (63.5 g per mole Cu).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Given Data and Atomic Masses\n\n| Quantity | Symbol | Value |\n|---|---|---|\n| Mass of mixture | \\(m_{\\text{tot}}\\) | 25.00 g |\n| Volume of AgNO₃ | \\(V\\) | 840 mL = 0.840 dm³ |\n| Concentration of AgNO₃ | \\(c\\) | 0.5 mol·dm⁻³ |\n| Initial mass of Cu strip | \\(m_{\\text{Cu,i}}\\) | 100.00 g |\n| Final mass of Cu strip | \\(m_{\\text{Cu,f}}\\) | 101.52 g |\n| Mass increase of Cu strip | \\(\\Delta m\\) | **1.52 g** |\n\n**Atomic masses (official IChO 1983 values):**\n\n\\[\n\\begin{aligned}\nA_r(\\mathrm{Cu}) &= 63.5 &\\qquad A_r(\\mathrm{Ag}) &= 108 \\\\\nA_r(\\mathrm{Na}) &= 23.0 &\\qquad A_r(\\mathrm{K}) &= 39.1 \\\\\nA_r(\\mathrm{Cl}) &= 35.5 & &\n\\end{aligned}\n\\]\n\n**Derived molar masses:**\n\n\\[\nM_r(\\mathrm{NaCl}) = 23.0 + 35.5 = 58.5\\;\\text{g·mol}^{-1}\n\\]\n\n\\[\nM_r(\\mathrm{KCl}) = 39.1 + 35.5 = 74.6\\;\\text{g·mol}^{-1}\n\\]\n\n\\[\nM_r(\\mathrm{AgNO_3}) = 108 + 14 + 3\\times 16 = 170\\;\\text{g·mol}^{-1}\n\\]\n\n---\n\n## 4. Step-by-Step Solution (Mass-Based Method)\n\n### Step 4.1 – Total amount of Ag⁺ added\n\n\\[\nn(\\mathrm{AgNO_3})_{\\text{total}} = V \\cdot c = 0.840\\;\\text{L} \\times 0.5\\;\\text{mol·L}^{-1} = 0.420\\;\\text{mol}\n\\]\n\n\\[\nm(\\mathrm{Ag^+})_{\\text{total}} = 0.420\\;\\text{mol} \\times 108\\;\\text{g·mol}^{-1} = 45.36\\;\\text{g}\n\\]\n\n### Step 4.2 – Excess Ag⁺ determined from the copper strip\n\nFrom the reaction stoichiometry: **2 mol Ag⁺** deposit 216 g Ag and dissolve 63.5 g Cu.  \nNet mass increase per 2 mol Ag⁺ consumed:\n\n\\[\n\\Delta m_{(2\\;\\text{mol Ag}^+)} = 2 \\times 108 - 63.5 = 216 - 63.5 = 152.5\\;\\text{g}\n\\]\n\nThe observed mass increase is 1.52 g. Therefore the mass of silver deposited on the strip is:\n\n\\[\nm(\\mathrm{Ag})_{\\text{deposited}} = 1.52 \\times \\frac{216}{152.5} = 2.15\\;\\text{g}\n\\]\n\n(Equivalently, \\(m(\\mathrm{Cu})_{\\text{dissolved}} = 2.15 - 1.52 = 0.63\\;\\text{g}\\).)\n\nThis 2.15 g of silver represents the **excess Ag⁺** that remained after precipitation.\n\n### Step 4.3 – Silver consumed by chloride precipitation\n\n\\[\nm(\\mathrm{Ag^+})_{\\text{consumed}} = 45.36\\;\\text{g} - 2.15\\;\\text{g} = 43.21\\;\\text{g} \\approx 43.2\\;\\text{g}\n\\]\n\n### Step 4.4 – Mass of chloride in the original sample\n\nFrom the precipitation stoichiometry: 108 g Ag⁺ precipitates 35.5 g Cl⁻. Therefore:\n\n\\[\nm(\\mathrm{Cl^-}) = 43.2 \\times \\frac{35.5}{108} = 14.2\\;\\text{g}\n\\]\n\n### Step 4.5 – Mass balance equations for NaCl and KCl\n\nLet \\(a\\) = mass of NaCl (g), \\(b\\) = mass of KCl (g).\n\n\\[\n\\begin{cases}\na + b = 25 & \\text{(total mass)} \\\\[8pt]\n\\dfrac{35.5}{58.5}\\,a + \\dfrac{35.5}{74.6}\\,b = 14.2 & \\text{(chloride mass)}\n\\end{cases}\n\\]\n\nThe coefficients represent the mass fraction of Cl⁻ in each salt:\n- NaCl: \\(35.5/58.5 = 0.60684\\)\n- KCl: \\(35.5/74.6 = 0.47587\\)\n\n### Step 4.6 – Solving the system\n\nSubstitute \\(b = 25 - a\\) into the second equation:\n\n\\[\n0.60684\\,a + 0.47587\\,(25 - a) = 14.2\n\\]\n\n\\[\n0.60684\\,a + 11.8968 - 0.47587\\,a = 14.2\n\\]\n\n\\[\n0.13097\\,a = 2.3032\n\\]\n\n\\[\na = \\frac{2.3032}{0.13097} = 17.58 \\approx 17.6\\;\\text{g (NaCl)}\n\\]\n\n\\[\nb = 25.0 - 17.6 = 7.4\\;\\text{g (KCl)}\n\\]\n\n### Step 4.7 – Mass percentages\n\n\\[\n\\%\\;\\mathrm{NaCl} = \\frac{17.6}{25.0} \\times 100\\% = \\mathbf{70.4\\%}\n\\]\n\n\\[\n\\%\\;\\mathrm{KCl} = \\frac{7.4}{25.0} \\times 100\\% = \\mathbf{29.6\\%}\n\\]\n\n---\n\n## 5. Alternative Solution (Mole-Based Method)\n\nThis approach is algebraically simpler and serves as an independent verification.\n\n### Step 5.1 – Total AgNO₃\n\n\\[\nn(\\mathrm{AgNO_3})_{\\text{total}} = 0.840 \\times 0.5 = 0.420\\;\\text{mol}\n\\]\n\n### Step 5.2 – Excess AgNO₃ from copper data\n\nPer mole of **excess Ag⁺** consumed, the mass change is:\n\n\\[\n\\Delta m_{\\text{per mol Ag}^+} = M_{\\mathrm{Ag}} - \\frac{M_{\\mathrm{Cu}}}{2} = 108 - \\frac{63.5}{2} = 108 - 31.75 = 76.25\\;\\text{g·mol}^{-1}\n\\]\n\n\\[\nn(\\mathrm{Ag^+})_{\\text{excess}} = \\frac{1.52}{76.25} = 0.01993\\;\\text{mol} \\approx 0.020\\;\\text{mol}\n\\]\n\n### Step 5.3 – Ag⁺ consumed by chloride\n\n\\[\nn(\\mathrm{Ag^+})_{\\text{consumed}} = 0.420 - 0.020 = 0.400\\;\\text{mol}\n\\]\n\nThis equals the total moles of Cl⁻ (and thus total moles of NaCl + KCl).\n\n### Step 5.4 – Solving for individual salts\n\nLet \\(x\\) = moles of NaCl, \\(y\\) = moles of KCl.\n\n\\[\n\\begin{cases}\nx + y = 0.400 & \\text{(mole balance)} \\\\\n58.5\\,x + 74.6\\,y = 25.0 & \\text{(mass balance)}\n\\end{cases}\n\\]\n\nSubstitute \\(y = 0.400 - x\\):\n\n\\[\n58.5\\,x + 74.6\\,(0.400 - x) = 25.0\n\\]\n\n\\[\n58.5\\,x + 29.84 - 74.6\\,x = 25.0\n\\]\n\n\\[\n-16.1\\,x = -4.84\n\\]\n\n\\[\nx = 0.3006\\;\\text{mol NaCl}\n\\]\n\n\\[\ny = 0.400 - 0.3006 = 0.0994\\;\\text{mol KCl}\n\\]\n\n### Step 5.5 – Masses and percentages\n\n\\[\nm_{\\mathrm{NaCl}} = 0.3006 \\times 58.5 = 17.59 \\approx 17.6\\;\\text{g} \\quad\\Rightarrow\\quad 70.4\\%\n\\]\n\n\\[\nm_{\\mathrm{KCl}} = 0.0994 \\times 74.6 = 7.41 \\approx 7.4\\;\\text{g} \\quad\\Rightarrow\\quad 29.6\\%\n\\]\n\nBoth methods yield the same result.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Layered Reasoning Chain\n\n| Node | Claim | Evidence / Derivation | Depends on |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| **R1** | All Cl⁻ from NaCl and KCl is precipitated quantitatively as AgCl by AgNO₃. | AgCl has very low solubility (\\(K_{sp} \\approx 1.8 \\times 10^{-10}\\)); the reaction Ag⁺ + Cl⁻ → AgCl(s) goes essentially to completion. | — (chemical principle) |\n| **R2** | Total AgNO₃ added = 0.420 mol. | \\(n = cV = 0.5\\;\\text{mol·dm}^{-3} \\times 0.840\\;\\text{dm}^3 = 0.420\\;\\text{mol}\\). | Given data |\n| **R3** | Copper displaces silver from solution quantitatively: Cu + 2Ag⁺ → Cu²⁺ + 2Ag. | Standard reduction potentials: \\(E^\\circ(\\mathrm{Ag^+/Ag}) = +0.80\\;\\text{V} > E^\\circ(\\mathrm{Cu^{2+}/Cu}) = +0.34\\;\\text{V}\\); reaction is thermodynamically spontaneous. | — (electrochemistry) |\n| **R4** | The mass increase of the Cu strip (1.52 g) equals mass of Ag deposited minus mass of Cu dissolved. | Mass conservation; stoichiometry Cu : Ag = 1 : 2. | R3, Given data |\n| **R5** | Mass of Ag deposited = 2.15 g; mass of Cu dissolved = 0.63 g. | Solved from system: \\(x - y = 1.52\\) and \\(y/x = 63.5/216\\). | R4, atomic masses |\n| **R6** | Excess Ag⁺ (unreacted with Cl⁻) corresponds to 2.15 g Ag = 0.01993 mol Ag⁺. | \\(n = m/M = 2.15/108 = 0.01993\\;\\text{mol}\\). | R5 |\n| **R7** | Ag⁺ consumed by Cl⁻ = total Ag⁺ − excess Ag⁺ = 0.420 − 0.01993 = 0.400 mol. | Conservation of Ag⁺. | R2, R6 |\n| **R8** | Total Cl⁻ in sample = 0.400 mol; Given Data\n\n| Quantity | Symbol | Value |\n|----------|--------|-------|\n| Total mass of mixture | \\(m_{\\text{tot}}\\) | 25.00 g |\n| Volume of AgNO₃ solution | \\(V\\) | 840 mL = 0.840 dm³ |\n| Concentration of AgNO₃ | \\(c\\) | 0.5 mol·dm⁻³ |\n| Initial mass of Cu strip | \\(m_{\\text{Cu,i}}\\) | 100.00 g |\n| Final mass of Cu strip | \\(m_{\\text{Cu,f}}\\) | 101.52 g |\n| Mass increase of Cu strip | \\(\\Delta m\\) | 1.52 g |\n\nAtomic masses (IUPAC 2013):\n- Na = 22.9898 g·mol⁻¹, K = 39.0983 g·mol⁻¹, Cl = 35.453 g·mol⁻¹\n- Ag = 107.8682 g·mol⁻¹, Cu = 63.546 g·mol⁻¹\n- \\(M_{\\text{NaCl}} = 58.4428\\ \\text{g·mol}^{-1}\\)\n- \\(M_{\\text{KCl}} = 74.5513\\ \\text{g·mol}^{-1}\\)\n\n---\n\n### 2. Chemical Reactions\n\n**Precipitation of chloride:**\n\\[\n\\text{Ag}^+ (aq) + \\text{Cl}^- (aq) \\rightarrow \\text{AgCl}(s)\n\\]\n\nAll Cl⁻ from NaCl and KCl is precipitated as AgCl, consuming an equal amount of Ag⁺.\n\n**Displacement of excess Ag⁺ by copper:**\n\\[\n\\text{Cu}(s) + 2\\text{Ag}^+ (aq) \\rightarrow \\text{Cu}^{2+}(aq) + 2\\text{Ag}(s)\n\\]\n\nThe copper strip gains mass because the mass of deposited Ag exceeds the mass of dissolved Cu.\n\n---\n\n### 3. Total Amount of Ag⁺ Added\n\n\\[\nn_{\\text{Ag,tot}} = V \\times c = 0.840\\ \\text{L} \\times 0.5\\ \\text{mol·L}^{-1} = 0.420\\ \\text{mol}\n\\]\n\n---\n\n### 4. Excess Ag⁺ from Copper Mass Change\n\nFrom the displacement stoichiometry:\n- 2 mol Ag⁺ produce 2 mol Ag(s) and consume 1 mol Cu(s).\n- For every 1 mol of excess Ag⁺:\n  - Mass of Ag deposited = \\(M_{\\text{Ag}}\\)\n  - Mass of Cu dissolved = \\(\\dfrac{M_{\\text{Cu}}}{2}\\)\n\n\\[\n\\Delta m = n_{\\text{Ag,ex}} \\times \\left(M_{\\text{Ag}} - \\frac{M_{\\text{Cu}}}{2}\\right)\n\\]\n\n\\[\nM_{\\text{Ag}} - \\frac{M_{\\text{Cu}}}{2} = 107.8682 - \\frac{63.546}{2} = 76.0952\\ \\text{g·mol}^{-1}\n\\]\n\n\\[\nn_{\\text{Ag,ex}} = \\frac{\\Delta m}{M_{\\text{Ag}} - M_{\\text{Cu}}/2} = \\frac{1.52}{76.0952} = 0.019975\\ \\text{mol}\n\\]\n\n---\n\n### 5. Given Data and Atomic Masses\n\n| Quantity | Symbol | Value |\n|---|---|---|\n| Mass of sample (NaCl + KCl) | \\( m_{\\text{tot}} \\) | 25 g |\n| Volume of AgNO₃ solution | \\( V \\) | 840 mL = 0.840 L |\n| Concentration of AgNO₃ | \\( c \\) | 0.5 mol·dm⁻³ |\n| Initial mass of copper strip | \\( m_{\\text{Cu,i}} \\) | 100.00 g |\n| Final mass of copper strip | \\( m_{\\text{Cu,f}} \\) | 101.52 g |\n| Mass increase of copper strip | \\( \\Delta m_{\\text{Cu}} \\) | 1.52 g |\n\n**Atomic masses used in the official IChO solution:**\n\n\\[\n\\begin{aligned}\nA_r(\\mathrm{Cu}) &= 63.5 \\quad & A_r(\\mathrm{Ag}) &= 108 \\\\\nA_r(\\mathrm{Na}) &= 23.0 \\quad & A_r(\\mathrm{K}) &= 39.1 \\\\\nA_r(\\mathrm{Cl}) &= 35.5 \\quad & A_r(\\mathrm{N}) &= 14 \\quad & A_r(\\mathrm{O}) &= 16\n\\end{aligned}\n\\]\n\n**Derived molar masses:**\n\n\\[\n\\begin{aligned}\nM_r(\\mathrm{NaCl}) &= 23.0 + 35.5 = 58.5 \\text{ g·mol}^{-1} \\\\\nM_r(\\mathrm{KCl}) &= 39.1 + 35.5 = 74.6 \\text{ g·mol}^{-1} \\\\\nM_r(\\mathrm{AgNO_3}) &= 108 + 14 + 3\\times 16 = 170 \\text{ g·mol}^{-1}\n\\end{aligned}\n\\]\n\n---\n\n## 3. After its dissolution in water 840 ml of AgNO₃ solution (c = 0.5 mol dm⁻³) is added. The precipitate is filtered off and a strip of copper weighing 100.00 g is dipped into the filtrate. After a given time interval the strip weights 101.52 g.\n> \n> Calculate the mass percent composition of the mixture.\n\n---\n\n### Official Solution\n\n#### Atomic / Molar Masses Used\n| Species | Symbol | Value |\n|---------|--------|-------|\n| Copper | Ar(Cu) | 63.5 |\n| Silver | Ar(Ag) | 108 |\n| Chlorine | Ar(Cl) | 35.5 |\n| Sodium chloride | Mr(NaCl) | 58.5 |\n| Potassium chloride | Mr(KCl) | 74.6 |\n\n(These imply Ar(Na) = 23.0, Ar(K) = 39.1.)\n\n---\n\n#### Step 1 – Total amount of AgNO₃ added\n\n\\[\nn(\\text{AgNO}_3) = V \\cdot c = 0.840\\ \\text{dm}^3 \\times 0.5\\ \\text{mol dm}^{-3} = 0.42\\ \\text{mol}\n\\]\n\n\\[\nm(\\text{AgNO}_3) = n \\cdot M = 0.42\\ \\text{mol} \\times 170\\ \\text{g mol}^{-1} = 71.4\\ \\text{g}\n\\]\n\n\\[\nm(\\text{Ag}^+)_{\\text{total}} = 0.42\\ \\text{mol} \\times 108\\ \\text{g mol}^{-1} = 45.36\\ \\text{g}\n\\]\n\n(Equivalently, the proportion: \\(\\frac{170\\ \\text{g AgNO}_3}{71.4\\ \\text{g AgNO}_3} = \\frac{108\\ \\text{g Ag}}{x} \\Rightarrow x = 45.36\\ \\text{g Ag}^+\\).)\n\n---\n\n#### Step 2 – Excess Ag⁺ determined from the copper strip\n\nCopper displaces silver from solution:\n\n\\[\n\\text{Cu} + 2\\ \\text{AgNO}_3 \\rightarrow \\text{Cu(NO}_3)_2 + 2\\ \\text{Ag}\n\\]\n\nMass increase of the strip:\n\n\\[\n\\Delta m = 101.52\\ \\text{g} - 100.00\\ \\text{g} = 1.52\\ \\text{g}\n\\]\n\nFor every 2 moles of Ag deposited (216 g), 1 mole of Cu dissolves (63.5 g); the net mass increase is \\(216 - 63.5 = 152.5\\ \\text{g}\\).\n\n\\[\nm(\\text{Ag}^+)_{\\text{excess}} = 1.52\\ \\text{g} \\times \\frac{216}{152.5} = 2.15\\ \\text{g}\n\\]\n\n---\n\n#### Step 3 – Silver consumed in the precipitation of chloride\n\n\\[\nm(\\text{Ag}^+)_{\\text{consumed}} = 45.36\\ \\text{g} - 2.15\\ \\text{g} = 43.21\\ \\text{g} \\quad (\\text{rounded to } 43.2\\ \\text{g})\n\\]\n\n---\n\n#### Step 4 – Mass of chloride in the original sample\n\nFrom the precipitation stoichiometry: 108 g Ag⁺ precipitates 35.5 g Cl⁻.\n\n\\[\n\\frac{108\\ \\text{g Ag}^+}{43.2\\ \\text{g Ag}^+} = \\frac{35.5\\ \\text{g Cl}^-}{x} \\quad\\Rightarrow\\quad x = 14.2\\ \\text{g Cl}^-\n\\]\n\n---\n\n#### Step 5 – Solving for the masses of NaCl and KCl\n\nLet:\n- \\(x\\) = mass of NaCl in the mixture\n- \\(y\\) = mass of KCl in the mixture\n\n\\[\nx + y = 25 \\tag{1}\n\\]\n\nChloride content:\n\n\\[\n\\text{Cl}^- \\text{ from NaCl} = \\frac{35.5}{58.5}\\,x \\qquad\n\\text{Cl}^- \\text{ from KCl} = \\frac{35.5}{74.6}\\,y\n\\]\n\n\\[\n\\frac{35.5}{58.5}\\,x + \\frac{35.5}{74.6}\\,y = 14.2 \\tag{2}\n\\]\n\nMultiplying (2) by the denominators and solving the system:\n\nFrom (1): \\(y = 25 - x\\). Substitute into (2):\n\n\\[\n0.60684\\,x + 0.47587\\,(25 - x) = 14.2\n\\]\n\\[\n0.60684\\,x + 11.8968 - 0.47587\\,x = 14.2\n\\]\n\\[\n0.13097\\,x = 2.3032\n\\]\n\\[\nx = 17.6\\ \\text{g NaCl}\n\\]\n\\[\ny = 2  …[+1270]"}]}]}</script>

From these data the mass percent composition of the original NaCl/KCl mixture is to be determined.\n\n---\n\n## 2.
